glass_staircases_with_lighting.gap: No published BSI standard addresses integrated LED lighting in glass staircase channels · heat management inside sealed glass · condensation risk on LED PCBs when routed through cold external glass balustrades.

painted_staircases_with_lighting.gap: No published UK standard addresses how LED heat from tread step-lights affects modern water-based paint systems on adjacent treads/risers/strings · yellowing risk from UV component of certain LED spectra on white acrylic paint · long-term paint film cracking around drilled LED apertures.
painted_staircases_with_lighting.why_expert_required: This is empirical finish-durability knowledge held by BWF Stair Scheme spraying workshops and coatings manufacturers (Blackfriar, Farrow & Ball, Little Greene, Sadolin) · not captured in a public standard.

section_13_trade_experience._scope: MOST IMPORTANT for this agent. Every item marked expert_experience_required with interview questions for certified BWF Stair Scheme members / RoSPA / senior installers. NO fabricated craft answers per governance rules 2 and 4.

customer_mistakes.why_expert_required: Craft knowledge from repeated customer interactions across hundreds of installs. Not documented in BWF/TRADA/CIBSE publications because it is behavioural rather than technical.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: What are the three most common mistakes homeowners make when specifying a new staircase, and how do you head them off at the quote stage?
How often do customers choose a tread material that is unsuitable for the traffic level in their home, and what are the tell-tale signs at survey?
When customers ask for open risers, how many change their mind after you explain the 100mm-sphere rule under Approved Document K and the child-fall interaction?
What percentage of your customers underestimate the width required at the top and bottom for furniture moves, and how do you counsel this before joinery is cut?
Which decorative aspiration causes the most warranty callbacks in your experience — glass, painted, or oil-finished oak?

design_regrets.why_expert_required: Follow-up feedback 3-10 years post-install is held only by manufacturers with long relationships to their customer base; not written up.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: Which staircase design decisions do customers most often regret 5 years later? Please rank the top three.
How often do customers who chose glass balustrades tell you they wish they had chosen timber (and vice versa) — and what practical factor drives the regret?
Do customers who chose tread-integrated LEDs report satisfaction 5 years later, or do they report driver failures / dead pixels / discoloured plastic diffusers?
For floating staircase installs, what post-install regrets do you hear most (echo · dust visibility · lighting glare · pet safety)?
Which paint colour / finish shows callback regret fastest in a family home with children?

lighting_positions_that_work_best.why_expert_required: CIBSE LG16 tells you WHERE to measure lux; only installers know which positions actually stay working, don't blind users mid-descent, and don't cast confusing shadows on the tread edge in a real home.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: Given a straight domestic flight, where do you fit LED step-lights (riser · underside of tread · string face · wall-mounted at ankle height) and why?
How do you decide between recessed wall step-lights (kick-height) and tread-underside LEDs when the staircase runs against a plasterboard wall?
For a cut-string cantilever staircase, where do you route the LED wiring so it doesn't compromise the mitre-return joint at the tread nosing?
What is your rule of thumb for LED colour temperature on stairs shared by elderly residents?
When do you specify motion-activated PIR vs. photocell-triggered dusk-to-dawn on a domestic stair?

lighting_positions_to_avoid.why_expert_required: Empirical field knowledge on positions that fail (heat build-up · dust ingress · maintenance-unfriendly · glare on descent) — not published.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: Which LED positions on a staircase do you refuse to install and why?
Have you seen LED step-lights recessed into the middle of a tread (rather than nosing edge) fail from foot compression, and how quickly?
Where does LED heat cause the most trouble in a timber staircase (adhesive line failure · veneer bubbling · paint yellowing)?
What positions cause glare on descent that users don't notice until after handover?
Which LED positions are unreachable for maintenance once the staircase is in service?

refacing_mistakes.why_expert_required: Refacing (tread overlay / cladding / painted retrofit) is a fragmented trade area with no BSI standard; failure modes are known only to installers.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: What are the most common mistakes homeowners make when they attempt to reface their own staircase with overlay treads?
Which existing staircase conditions (loose wedges · rot at string ends · squeaks) MUST be fixed before an overlay is applied, and which are commonly ignored to the customer's cost?
When a customer asks for an oak-veneer overlay on a painted pine staircase, what preparation errors have you seen cause the finish to fail within 2 years?
What glue and fixing combinations do you recommend for overlay treads on a residential stair — and which combinations have you seen fail?
Does painting over an existing carpet-gripper-nailed tread ever succeed long-term, or should the customer always be told to remove the tread first?

material_combinations_that_age_poorly.why_expert_required: 10-year visual ageing data is not captured in any UK standard; only long-established manufacturers see it.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: Which timber-with-metal combinations have you seen age poorly on a staircase (e.g. oak with brass · walnut with brushed steel · pine with chrome)?
What paint-finish + timber-species combinations show the most yellowing/cracking after 5 years of family use?
When customers pair painted stringers with oiled treads, what edge-line failure modes appear over time?
Do you have observed cases where oak tannin interacted with aluminium LED extrusions to cause corrosion or discolouration?
Which glass-tinting + LED-lighting combinations have shown premature colour drift?

products_professionals_avoid.why_expert_required: Trade-only preference data. Never printed publicly because vendors would object; only held in the heads of specifiers.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: Which categories of stair-lighting product (not specific brands) do you personally never fit, and why?
Which LED driver categories have you seen fail within 2 years on stair installations?
Are there any tread-overlay product categories you refuse to quote for, and what is your reason?
Which handrail-integrated LED systems have caused you callbacks, and what was the root cause?
Which balustrade fixing systems have you stopped specifying and why?

finishes_that_fail_prematurely.why_expert_required: Finish-failure timeline knowledge sits with coatings representatives (Blackfriar · Bona · Osmo · Rubio Monocoat · Sadolin · Sikkens · Manns) and stair installers, not with BSI.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: Rank the top three tread finish systems by longevity in a family home (oil · hardwax oil · lacquer · pre-cat lacquer · UV-cured factory finish).
How quickly does water-based paint fail at the tread-nose leading edge in a busy household compared to oil-based?
Which factory-applied UV-cured finishes have you seen fail earliest, and what was the failure mode (edge chipping · wear-through · yellowing)?
When customers insist on a matt finish on treads, what is your typical touch-up cadence advice?
Which underside-of-tread stains have you seen bleed through a subsequent paint job?

common_warranty_claims.why_expert_required: Warranty-claim distributions are commercial data not published by the BWF Stair Scheme. Only individual manufacturers hold it.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: What are your five most common warranty callback reasons in the first 12 months, ranked by frequency?
How many of your warranty claims trace to installation issues vs. manufacturing defects vs. customer misuse?
What proportion of LED-related warranty claims are driver failures vs. LED strip failures vs. installation faults?
Which warranty claim category has grown fastest in the last 3 years?
What is the typical time-to-first-callback for painted staircases in family homes?

installation_shortcuts_that_cause_future.why_expert_required: Site-installer shortcuts are known only to workshops that get called back to fix them. Never documented for obvious reasons.
suggested_interview_questions_for_certif: What are the three most common installation shortcuts you see when you're called out to fix another installer's staircase?
How often do you find pine wedges that were shorter than the recommended 9-12 inches, and what failure mode results?
How often do you find riser tongues that were NOT properly seated 12mm into the tread underside groove, and what shows the failure (light-leak / squeak / step separation)?
How often do you find that the string-to-newel housing was under-glued or improperly haunched?
How often do you find LED wiring routed through structural timber in a way that violates BS 7671 zoning?
